tree.label: Workspace
tree.note: The whole Notion workspace. Two halves: the sidebar (everything you navigate) and workspace settings (everything you administer). Zoom in and fall all the way down to a single block.

children.label: Sidebar
children.note: The left navigation. Your entry point to search, home, inbox, teamspaces, shared and private pages, settings, templates and trash.

children.label: Search
children.note: Quick find across the workspace (Cmd/Ctrl+P).

children.label: Notion AI
children.note: Ask, search and generate with AI across your pages.

children.label: Home
children.note: Personalized home: recents, upcoming events and tasks.

children.label: Inbox
children.note: All notifications, mentions and page updates.

children.label: Teamspaces
children.note: A team's home. Holds its pages and databases and controls who can see them. A workspace can hold many teamspaces.

children.label: Teamspace settings
children.note: Members, owners and the access level of the teamspace.

children.label: Members & owners
children.note: Add people and assign owners.

children.label: Open
children.note: Anyone in the workspace can join and view.

children.label: Closed
children.note: Discoverable; people request access; only members contribute.

children.label: Private
children.note: Invite only and hidden from everyone else.

children.label: Default
children.note: Every member is added automatically.

children.label: Database
children.note: A collection of pages that share properties. Same content engine as a page, but structured. This is the split from a page.

children.label: Data source
children.note: The underlying collection of rows. One database block can surface one or more sources.

children.label: collection
children.note: Each source has its own ID, property schema and rows.

children.label: Pages (rows)
children.note: Every row IS a page. Open one and you are back in the Page world.

children.label: Open as page
children.note: A row opens as a full page. Click to bounce to the Page level.

children.label: Properties
children.note: Typed columns shared by every row.

children.label: Views
children.note: Different lenses on the same rows.

children.label: View options
children.note: Open pages in side peek / center / full, card preview, page size, shown properties, vertical lines.

children.label: Filters
children.note: Show only the rows that match.

children.label: Condition
children.note: is / is not / contains / before / after.

children.label: Automations
children.note: When something happens, do something.

children.label: Triggers
children.note: Property edited, Page added, On a schedule, Button clicked.

children.label: Actions
children.note: Edit property, Add page, Send notification, Slack, Email, Webhook.

children.label: Page
children.note: The atom of Notion. A title, an icon and cover, and a stack of blocks. Almost everything is a page.

children.label: Add icon
children.note: Emoji, upload or link.

children.label: Title
children.note: The page name. Also the Title property when the page lives in a database.

children.label: Blocks
children.note: The content. Every line is a block you can drag, transform and nest.

children.label: 6-dot handle
children.note: Drag to move or reorder. Click it to open the block menu.

children.label: Add block
children.note: The plus and the slash menu to insert any block.

children.label: Block menu
children.note: Actions on the selected block.

children.label: Move to
children.note: Move the block or page somewhere else. Bounces to the Teamspace level.

children.label: Block types
children.note: What a block can be.

children.label: Basic
children.note: Text, H1, H2, H3, bulleted, numbered, to-do, toggle, quote, divider, callout.

children.label: Media
children.note: Image, video, audio, file, web bookmark, embed.

children.label: Database blocks
children.note: Table, board, gallery, list, calendar, timeline, chart, linked view.

children.label: Advanced
children.note: Table of contents, button, breadcrumb, synced block, table, columns, code, math, mermaid, toggle heading.

children.label: Inline
children.note: Mention a person, page or date, reminder, emoji, inline equation.

children.label: AI blocks
children.note: AI summary, AI custom block, AI autofill.

children.label: Share
children.note: Who can do what on this page. Page-level access can override the teamspace.

children.label: Full access
children.note: Edit, share and manage who has access.

children.label: Can edit
children.note: Edit content and sub-pages.

children.label: Can edit content
children.note: Edit content but not restructure.

children.label: Can comment
children.note: Comment and view, no edits.

children.label: Can view
children.note: Read only.

children.label: No access - can create
children.note: Cannot view this page but can create within it.

children.label: Page-level access
children.note: Override the inherited teamspace permissions on this page.

children.label: Comments
children.note: Page-level discussion thread shown at the top of the page.

children.label: Page settings
children.note: The menu in the top-right. Everything you can do TO a page.

children.label: Move to
children.note: Pick a new parent teamspace or page. Bounces you to the Teamspace level.

children.label: Move to trash
children.note: Send to Trash. Bounces you up to Trash in the sidebar.

children.label: Present
children.note: Full-screen presentation mode.

children.label: Customize page
children.note: Tune what shows around the content.

children.label: Backlinks
children.note: Expanded / Show in popover / Off.

children.label: Page discussions
children.note: Show or hide the top-of-page comments.

children.label: Table of contents
children.note: Show or hide a sticky outline.

children.label: Inline comments
children.note: Minimal / Default.

children.label: Turn into Wiki
children.note: Add an owner and verification; sub-pages gain properties.

children.label: Updates & analytics
children.note: Activity and reach for this page.

children.label: Updates
children.note: On-page edit history you can restore from.

children.label: Analytics
children.note: Who is viewing and editing, and how often.

children.label: Settings: view history
children.note: Show or hide your own view history for this page.

children.label: Version history
children.note: Snapshots over time; restore any of them.

children.label: Connections
children.note: Apps connected to this page.

children.label: Manage connections
children.note: Jumps out to workspace-level Connections, several levels up. Click to bounce up and over.

children.label: Shared
children.note: Pages shared across teamspaces or with guests.

children.label: Private
children.note: Pages only you can see.

children.label: Settings
children.note: Opens workspace and account settings. Click to bounce over.

children.label: Templates
children.note: Prebuilt pages and databases to start from.

children.label: Trash
children.note: Deleted pages live here for 30 days. Restore or purge.

children.label: Calendar
children.note: The Notion Calendar app, linked to your events.

children.label: Workspace settings
children.note: Account and workspace administration. The other half of the workspace.

children.label: Appearance
children.note: Light / dark / system.

children.label: My connections
children.note: Personal app connections (Slack, GitHub and more).

children.label: Danger zone
children.note: Delete the workspace.

children.label: Teamspaces
children.note: Manage every teamspace. Bounces to the Teamspaces level.

children.label: Connections
children.note: Workspace-wide app connections. This is exactly where Manage connections lands from deep inside a page.

children.label: Import
children.note: Bring in Evernote, Confluence, CSV, Word and more.

children.label: Plan
children.note: Free / Plus / Business / Enterprise.

children.label: Sites
children.note: Pages published as websites.
